audit: P10-WP1 three-profile port parity (ADR-048 O-03, DB-002, DB-008, DB-01)

two_way_equivalence.scope: metadata CAS + revision + content-derived etag + stable key order over five identical writes
two_way_equivalence.not_verified: three-way equivalence (profile C needs PostgreSQL, Qdrant and Neo4j)

profiles.name: embedded
profiles.transport: single JSON snapshot file, atomic flush
profiles.evidence: profile_a_embedded_json_serves_every_port runs the shared canonical contract plus derived projections and reloads the store
limits: single process, single writer; no cross-process locking
full text and vector are derived projections: rebuilt from canonical data plus outbox replay
durability is obtained at flush(), not per mutation

profiles.name: sql
profiles.transport: SQLite (WAL, synchronous=FULL) in real SQL transactions; rusqlite bundled, no server required
profiles.evidence: profile_b_sqlite_passes_the_same_contract runs the identical contract against the SQL backend, checkpoints, reopens and checks the SQL file size
limits: one process opens the database; multi-process contention is not managed beyond WAL
full text and vector are derived projections (same rule as profile A)
no native graph traversal (GraphPort is served by graph-engine stores)

profiles.name: hybrid
profiles.reason: ukma-adapter-postgres, ukma-adapter-qdrant and ukma-adapter-neo4j declare themselves unavailable: no client dependency and no server available in this environment. Profile C cannot be exercised until all three servers exist and the adapters pass the same contract
